text: GM reported Q3 adjusted EPS of $3.70 and revenue of $50.02B, both above estimates. Full-year adjusted EPS guidance narrowed to $12.75-$13.75, with automotive free cash flow raised to $11.5B-$12.5B. GM announced a $20B buyback; shares fell roughly 6%.

meta.note: Quarterly earnings outperformance and full-year guidance expectations reflect different comparison bases.

text: September pending home sales fell 7.3% MoM and 11.3% YoY as 30-year mortgage rates rose from 6.8% to 7.6%. Single-family housing starts declined 4.56% to 859,000 annualized, while permits fell 4%. October homebuilder sentiment reached a 14-year low.

meta.note: Sales contracts, construction activity, and builder sentiment represent distinct housing-market measures.

text: The FAA approved Boeing's 737 Max 10 following extended certification delays and review of a navigation system issue. The aircraft seats up to 230 passengers and represents approximately 30% of Boeing's 737 Max backlog. U.S. transportation officials identified certification speed as a competitive constraint.

meta.note: Aircraft certification is complete; airline deliveries and passenger service remain separate operational states.

text: Netflix reported Q3 EPS of $0.87 versus $0.82 expected and revenue of $12.87B, up nearly 12% YoY. Full-year revenue guidance narrowed to $51.1B, while advertising revenue guidance fell from $3B to $2.7B. Shares declined approximately 6% after hours.

meta.note: Subscription and advertising performance are distinct components; viewership concerns lack a quantified quarterly measure.
